name: dogfood
description: An AI QA system: a local, page-by-page QA workspace: every page, its checks, its evidence, and what is still unproven.

scripts.check: for f in server.mjs mcp.mjs lib/*.mjs public/app.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && DOGFOOD_DATA=demo node scripts/check-projects.mjs
scripts.test:acceptance: for f in tests/acceptance/*.mjs; do echo "$f"; node "$f" || exit 1; done
